overview_description.description: Spreadd is a CreatorTech and AdTech SaaS platform that connects brands, marketers, and content creators to collaborate on digital marketing campaigns and monetize online content. The platform uses AI-powered tools and analytics to help creators grow their audience, manage brand partnerships, and generate revenue from their content. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, Spreadd operates as a technology platform focused on the creator economy, enabling efficient collaboration between influencers and companies.
